question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**vision**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage mentions that ostriches can see well over great distances because of their height and keen **vision**.
 
• **Vision** refers to the ability to see, which logically fits the context.
 
• Other options like **delusion**, **illusion**, and **allusion** do not fit the meaning or context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The eye of an ostrich is larger than its brain. Of all birds, ostriches have the 1.**biggest __**eyes. Their eyes are the size of a pool ball, measuring around 2 inches in diameter. Their size is five times greater than that of human eyes. Ostriches have excellent vision, so their enormous eyes aren't just for show. Because of their height and keen 2. __**vision**__, the birds can see well over great distances, enabling them to identify potential 3._________ before they approach. In general, compared to mammals of comparable size, birds often have smaller brains. Ostrich brains are approximately 1.5 inches in width, the study found. Additionally, their average brain weight is almost 17 times lower than that of the three other 4._____. When comparing the brain-to-body weight ratio of the other birds, the ostrich's brain was lighter than their body weight. Some other facts concerning these birds are what set them apart. All other birds have three or four toes; this magnificent creature has only two. Ostriches bend their knees in a forward orientation; thus, they kick forward rather than backward. Furthermore, ostriches do not require water because they produce some of it internally and obtain the 5._______ from the plants they consume.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Delusion:** A false belief, which does not fit the context of eyesight.
 
• **Illusion:** A deceptive appearance, inappropriate here.
 
• **Allusion:** An indirect reference, which makes no sense in the context.
